item.title: [Message Center] MC1550542 Microsoft Teams: Updated recording and transcript access setting behavior for town halls and webinars
item.description:
Microsoft Teams is updating the "Who has access to the recording or transcript" option for Events App town halls and webinars. It will depend on the RecordingForTownhall or RecordingForWebinar settings instead of AllowCloudRecording. The change rolls out worldwide in early to mid-November 2026 with no action required.

Microsoft Teams · preventOrFixIssue

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1550540 Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Workspaces is replacing standalone agent selection with agentic chat
item.description:
Microsoft 365 Copilot Workspaces will replace standalone agent selection (Researcher, Analyst, Designer) with an agentic chat that applies skills based on user requests. This simplifies workflows without losing capabilities. The change begins December 2026 in Frontier preview, with no admin action required. Separate agents remain in the Copilot app.

Microsoft 365 apps · planForChange

item.title: [Message Center] MC1550533 Scheduled prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot are moving to native Copilot scheduling and the Tasks view
item.description:
Microsoft 365 Copilot is moving scheduled prompts from Power Platform to native Copilot scheduling, enabling automatic execution of one-time or recurring tasks within Microsoft 365 compliance boundaries. The Power Platform-based experience retires December 31, 2026. Users manage tasks via the Copilot app's Tasks > Scheduled view.

Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) · Plan for Change · act by 2026-12-31

item.title: [New] Microsoft's 12 November Graph permission sync maps Teams chat message replies to nine Chat and ChatMessage permissions and drops two account-takeover-protection endpoints
item.description:

Graph · List apps granted Chat.*.All or ChatMessage.Read.All and confirm their owners expect reply content; keep MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs queries for /chats/ calls broad enough to match /replies.

item.title: [Due in 4 days] Enterprise Agreement billing roles: new assignments must use work or school accounts from 16 November, a month later than Microsoft first wrote
item.description:
Enterprise Agreement roles are assigned outside Entra roles and Azure RBAC. Microsoft's page says an Enterprise administrator can 'Create new subscriptions under active enrollment accounts' and an Account owner can 'Manage subscription role assignments'. A personal Microsoft account holding one of them signs in outside the tenant's Conditional Access and sign-in logs (inferred). The cut-off for new assignments moved by a month; existing assignments are not touched yet.

Azure · deadline 2026-11-16 · List the Enterprise Agreement billing role assignments in Cost Management + Billing and move every personal Microsoft account to a work or school account before 16 November 2026, starting with Enterprise administrators and Account owners.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] ReFS on removable media: audit phase since the October 2026 update, blocking becomes the default with the January 2027 Windows security update
item.description:
Removable ReFS volumes are an unsupported, attacker-reachable file-system surface; the audit events list where blocking will break something in January.

Windows · Collect the ReFS audit events for removable media now, migrate the workflows they show, and enable blocking in a test ring before the January 2027 update makes it the default.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Copilot Workspaces replaces standalone Researcher, Analyst and Designer selection with one agentic chat; Frontier preview from December 2026
item.description:
Which skill touches workspace content is now chosen by Copilot, not by the user; data-handling reviews that were written per agent need a second look.

Copilot · Update user guidance for Copilot Workspaces and check that your AI-use review covers skills Copilot applies automatically.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Custom authentication strengths that allow SMS or voice but not passkeys will block sign-in when SMS and voice retire: from 1 February 2027 for users, from 1 July 2027 for Global Administrators and external users
item.description:
A Conditional Access policy that requires a custom authentication strength without passkeys turns the SMS/voice retirement into a hard sign-in block, including for Global Administrators from 1 July 2027.

Entra · List custom authentication strengths that allow SMS or voice, add passkeys (FIDO2) to each, and check which Conditional Access policies (break-glass and admin policies first) require them, before 1 February 2027.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Scheduled prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot move from Power Platform to native Copilot scheduling; the Power Platform-based experience retires on 31 December 2026
item.description:
Unattended Copilot runs no longer pass through Power Platform, so a tenant that relied on disabling Power Automate to stop scheduled Copilot tasks loses that control.

Copilot · Before 31 December 2026, tell users who rely on scheduled prompts to recreate schedules that do not migrate, and review which Copilot controls now govern unattended scheduled tasks.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 6 days] Workforce Insights endpoint in MODS retires 18 November; custom non-public attributes such as job level move to the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint and become visible to Copilot experiences
item.description:
Non-public HR attributes such as job level that were scoped to one Frontier agent become available to Copilot experiences generally once they move to the profile endpoint, which is a data-exposure decision for privacy and governance, not a plumbing change.

Copilot · deadline 2026-11-18 · If you upload custom attributes to the Workforce Insights endpoint, list them, agree an access policy with privacy stakeholders, then re-select the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint before 18 November.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 4 days] Teams consolidates GitHub Notifications and GitHub Copilot into one GitHub app; the legacy app is deprecated by 16 November 2026
item.description:
A new third-party app identity replaces the old one, so an app permission policy that allowed the legacy GitHub app does not automatically cover the new one, and its consent must be reviewed like any new app.

Teams · deadline 2026-11-16 · Check the Teams app permission policies and the Entra consent granted to the new GitHub app before 16 November, and remove the legacy app from allow lists afterwards.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 5 days] Viva Glint: the Service Admin role gets access to every report attribute from 17 November 2026
item.description:
A role that today sees a restricted set of survey attributes will see all of them, so anyone holding Service Admin gains access to employee survey data they could not read before.

Viva · deadline 2026-11-17 · List who holds the Viva Glint Service Admin role before 17 November and move people who only need reports to a narrower role.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 3 days] Exchange Online stops returning selected properties from Get-Mailbox -Migration on 15 November and blocks setting them through New-Mailbox -Migration on 15 December
item.description:
Mailbox-migration and onboarding scripts that read these properties will get empty values without an error, so a provisioning or audit job can silently produce wrong output.

Exchange Online · deadline 2026-11-15 · Search automation, runbooks and third-party migration tools for Get-Mailbox -Migration and New-Mailbox -Migration before 15 November, compare the properties they read with Microsoft's list, and test the scripts against a tenant where the change has landed.

item.title: [Due today] Copilot Studio retires GPT-4.1, GPT-5 Chat/Auto/Reasoning and GPT 5.6 Sol/Luna on 12 November and migrates agents automatically
item.description:
An automatic model swap changes agent behaviour, including how it handles tool calls and grounding, without an owner approving it.

Copilot Studio · deadline 2026-11-12 · Inventory agents by model in the Power Platform admin center and have owners test the replacement before 12 November.

item.title: [Due in 3 days] App Governance permissions change for three Entra roles as Defender XDR Unified RBAC takes over
item.description:
Two compliance roles silently lose an app-governance capability and one security role gains it: an app-governance policy nobody can edit, or one an unexpected role can now edit, is a control gap either way.

Defender XDR · deadline 2026-11-15 · Before mid-November, list who reaches App Governance through Compliance Administrator, Compliance Data Administrator or Cloud App Security Administrator, review custom Defender XDR Unified RBAC roles for Defender for Cloud Apps, and reassign affected people to a supported Entra role or a custom Unified RBAC role on least privilege.

item.title: [New] ThreatHunting.ReadWrite.All enters Microsoft's Graph permissions file with 13 endpoints: run hunting queries and create, change and delete saved hunting functions
item.description:
An app granted this permission can rewrite or delete the saved hunting functions detection engineers build queries on, not only read data; it is a write path into shared detection logic and is not yet described on Learn.

Graph · Alert on any consent or app-role assignment of ThreatHunting.ReadWrite.All (AuditLogs: 'Add app role assignment to service principal' with the Application ID 6e251752-0d87-4158-b87b-b60e768fa657) and keep hunting automation on ThreatHunting.Read.All unless it must write functions.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Windows clients offer NTLM message signing by default from the November 2026 updates; servers require it from May 2027 (CVE-2026-118737)
item.description:
Default signing cuts NTLM relay exposure, and the new audit events are the list of devices and appliances that will be refused by servers in May 2027.

Windows · Install the November 2026 Windows updates, collect the NTLM signing audit events (KB5135557) to find clients and appliances that do not sign, and plan to require signing before May 2027.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Copilot Studio agents let users create third-party service connections inside the chat, reusing an existing connection where possible; GA by 31 December 2026
item.description:
Fewer clicks between a user and a new OAuth connection to a third-party service means connector data-loss-prevention policies become the only control on what agents can reach.

Copilot Studio · Review Power Platform connector DLP policies and connection sharing for Copilot Studio environments before GA; tell owners of custom-canvas agents on the Standard harness to update their implementation.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Intune raises the minimum iOS/iPadOS Company Portal to v5.2608.0 from early December; devices that block App Store installs need a pushed update
item.description:
A device stuck on an older Company Portal can fall out of enrolment and compliance flows, which Conditional Access device-compliance policies depend on.

Intune · If 'Block installing apps using App Store' is enabled for supervised iOS/iPadOS devices, push Company Portal v5.2608.0 before early December; warn the help desk about the update prompt.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Entra MFA shows non-telephony methods before SMS and voice and adds a resend wait; Microsoft re-posted it on 10 November with the content unchanged
item.description:
The resend wait looks like an SMS delivery failure to users and the help desk, and help-desk MFA resets are the social-engineering path attackers use.

Entra · Brief the help desk that a resend wait is not a delivery failure and that SMS/voice sit under 'Show more verification methods'; keep moving users to passkeys before 1 February 2027.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Outlook on the web and new Outlook block .msix and .msixbundle attachments by default; Microsoft moved the rollout to early-to-mid December 2026
item.description:
MSIX packages are an established malware-delivery format (App Installer abuse); the default block closes an attachment path, and a tenant that adds them to AllowedFileTypes keeps it open deliberately.

Exchange Online · Check Get-OwaMailboxPolicy for AllowedFileTypes containing .msix or .msixbundle; add them only where a business case exists, before early December.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1548004 Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: Filter responses by content source
item.description:
Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat now lets users filter responses by selecting specific content sources, ensuring answers are grounded only in chosen data while respecting permissions. This feature, enabled by default for licensed users, rolls out worldwide in mid-November 2026 with no required action but recommends reviewing connector names and permissions.

Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) · Stay Informed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1548000 Microsoft Viva Glint: Integration with Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service generally available
item.description:
Microsoft Viva Glint now integrates with Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service for centralized employee data management, improving quality and governance. Rolling out from mid-November 2026 to late September 2027, it requires onboarding by existing customers, supports multiple connectors and tenants, and offers enhanced monitoring, compliance, and import options.

Microsoft Viva · Stay Informed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1546447 Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Updated recipient inclusion logic for threat protection policies
item.description:
Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will change recipient inclusion logic in threat protection policies from Match all (AND) to Match any (OR) when multiple recipient types are specified. This update, rolling out in December 2026, expands policy scope upon modification but does not auto-convert existing policies.

Microsoft Defender XDR · stayInformed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1546438 Action may be required: Claude models in Copilot are coming into the EU Data Boundary and will be enabled by default
item.description:
Starting December 9, 2026, Claude models in Microsoft Copilot will be enabled by default for eligible EU and EFTA tenants, with data processing moved into the EU Data Boundary. Admins can opt out or limit access before that date via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat · planForChange · act by 2026-12-09

item.title: [Message Center] MC1546430 'Add explainer video' Skill in PPT Copilot
item.description:
The "Add explainer video" skill in PowerPoint Copilot, available on desktop, Mac, and web, will roll out to Frontier users worldwide from early to mid-November 2026. It converts static slides into animated explainer videos. No admin action or compliance concerns are required.

Microsoft 365 apps · stayInformed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1546429 Power BI retiring standalone Copilot experiences (preview)
item.description:
Power BI will retire the standalone Copilot preview in January 2027, replacing it with Microsoft 365 Copilot enabled by default from December 8, 2026. Standalone Copilot access and settings will be removed; organizations should prepare for this transition and notify users accordingly.

Power BI · planForChange · act by 2026-12-08

item.title: [Message Center] MC1546411 Retirement of Viva Insights (personal insights) and Viva Learning usage reports
item.description:
Viva Insights personal insights and Viva Learning usage reports will be retired from the Microsoft 365 admin center by mid-November 2026. Viva Learning analytics remain accessible within the Viva Learning app. Admins should update documentation and inform reporting administrators of this change.

Microsoft 365 suite · planForChange

item.title: [Message Center] MC1546409 Microsoft Teams: Retirement of off-network invitations to Teams Free
item.description:
Microsoft Teams will retire off-network invitations for Teams Free accounts starting December 2026. Users can no longer invite external people via email or chat links to create Teams Free accounts. Existing Teams Free collaboration and federation remain unchanged. No admin action is needed, but user guidance should be updated.

Microsoft Teams · planForChange

item.title: [New] November 2026 Windows security update is out for every supported Windows and Windows Server, with separate PowerShell fixes for hotpatch devices and no December preview update
item.description:

Windows · Deploy the November update through the usual rings; on hotpatch-enrolled Windows 11 and Server 2025 devices confirm KB5135385 / KB5135386 is also installed, and plan for no December preview update.

item.title: [New] Defender for Office 365 threat policies switch multi-condition recipient targeting from AND to OR; an existing policy converts when an admin next edits it, and its scope can widen
item.description:
A policy written as 'users in group X AND in domain Y' becomes 'X OR Y' on its next edit, so an anti-phishing, Safe Links or Safe Attachments policy meant for a narrow population can silently start applying to a whole domain, and a stricter policy can override the one the SOC expects for those mailboxes.

Defender XDR · Before December, export the recipient conditions of every threat policy (Get-AntiPhishRule, Get-SafeLinksRule, Get-SafeAttachmentRule, Get-HostedContentFilterRule) and flag those that combine two condition types; review each one's OR scope before anyone edits it.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.description:

item.title: [New] Workforce Insights endpoint in MODS retires 18 November; custom non-public attributes such as job level move to the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint and become visible to Copilot experiences
item.description:
Non-public HR attributes such as job level that were scoped to one Frontier agent become available to Copilot experiences generally once they move to the profile endpoint, which is a data-exposure decision for privacy and governance, not a plumbing change.

Copilot · If you upload custom attributes to the Workforce Insights endpoint, list them, agree an access policy with privacy stakeholders, then re-select the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint before 18 November.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Copilot Cowork gains Power Platform connectors governed only from the Microsoft 365 admin center; Power Platform DLP policies do not apply to Cowork
item.description:
A tenant that relies on Power Platform DLP to keep business data away from third-party connectors has no such control over Cowork: the only gate is the admin-center connector list, and every connector Microsoft adds there becomes usable in Cowork as it arrives.

Copilot · Before mid-November review Agents > Tools in the Microsoft 365 admin center, block the Power Platform connectors your DLP policies forbid, and record that Power Platform DLP does not cover Cowork.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1542066 Microsoft 365 Copilot: Changes to custom organizational data in MODS for Workforce Insights
item.description:
Microsoft 365 is retiring the Workforce Insights endpoint in MODS by November 18, 2026. Custom organizational data will now be ingested via the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint. Organizations using non-public attributes must join a private preview and switch before the deadline to continue data uploads.

Microsoft 365 suite · planForChange · act by 2026-11-18

item.title: [Message Center] MC1542062 Copilot Cowork: Power Platform connectors now follow Microsoft 365 admin center settings
item.description:
Microsoft Copilot Cowork now supports Power Platform connectors managed via the Microsoft 365 admin center, allowing centralized control over connector use with third-party apps. Rollout completes by mid-November 2026. Admins should review and configure connector availability, noting that Power Platform DLP policies do not apply to Cowork.

Power Platform, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), Microsoft Copilot (Power Platform) · Plan for Change

item.title: [New] Entra Hard Deletion Protection (preview): a protected user, cloud group, app or service principal cannot be permanently deleted for seven days after soft delete, and the protection can never be removed
item.description:
A destructive intruder with Global Administrator can soft delete and then hard delete break-glass accounts, Conditional Access exclusion groups or critical app registrations in minutes; a seven-day floor turns that into a recoverable event, and the audit record of enabling it is a new event to watch.

Entra · Pilot it on break-glass accounts, privileged-access groups and the service principals your SOC tooling depends on, remembering it cannot be removed; add the enable event and blocked hard-delete attempts to your Entra audit detections.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] SharePoint Online and OneDrive web search becomes Copilot Search with AI summaries; general availability from mid-January 2027, deferrable per tenant and per site
item.description:
Search that summarises what a user can reach makes oversharing visible to more people faster; it does not change permissions.

SharePoint · Test custom search integrations and decide whether to defer at tenant or site level; pair with the new Data access governance report (MC1540348) to clean up oversharing first.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] SharePoint admin center gains a Data access governance report that lists every site a given group can reach and how far
item.description:
Broad or vendor groups that reach sensitive sites are the oversharing Copilot amplifies; the report answers 'what can this group see' without scripting.

SharePoint · Once it appears, run it for Everyone except external users, vendor groups and large dynamic groups, and fix the sites that should not be reachable before assigning more Copilot licences.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Exchange Online Admin API v2.0 drops Exchange.ManageV2 and Exchange.ManageAsAppV2 on 1 December; apps must move to Exchange.AdminAPI.Manage / .ManageAsApp and get fresh admin consent
item.description:
Every automation and third-party tool that administers Exchange through the Admin API needs a new consent grant this month; a rushed tenant-wide consent on an app-only Exchange administration permission is exactly the grant an attacker hopes to slip through, and a missed one breaks the tool on 1 December.

Exchange Online · Inventory service principals holding Exchange.ManageV2 or Exchange.ManageAsAppV2, grant the replacement only to apps you still need, verify their Exchange RBAC role, test, then remove the old permission before 1 December; alert on consent to Exchange.AdminAPI.ManageAsApp in AuditLogs.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Exchange Online Admin API MailboxFolderPermission returns User as an object (DisplayName, Name, PrimarySmtpAddress) instead of a string from early November
item.description:
Scripts that audit mailbox folder delegation (a classic BEC persistence check) may silently fail or mis-attribute users after the change; the new PrimarySmtpAddress removes display-name ambiguity.

Exchange Online · Find scripts and tools that read MailboxFolderPermission through the Admin API, switch them to the User object and key on PrimarySmtpAddress, and re-run your folder-permission audit after the change.

item.title: [New] Microsoft asks admins to shorten the time from Windows security update release to deployment, because AI speeds up exploit development from published fixes
item.description:
Patch latency is an exposure window an attacker can now close faster; this post is Microsoft's own argument for a shorter deployment ring on Windows endpoints and servers.

Windows · Measure the median days from Patch Tuesday to 95% deployment per ring, and evaluate Autopatch or hotpatch for the rings that miss it.

item.title: [New] Agents can read a user's Copilot memory profile through a new Work IQ MCP path from early December, under a read policy that is ON by default
item.description:
Any agent granted the Work IQ MCP server gains a summary of what a user has told Copilot and what Copilot inferred from their chat history, without a new admin decision, because the read policy ships enabled.

Copilot · Before early December, decide whether agents should read Copilot memory at all; if not, disable the Work IQ MCP memory read policy in the Microsoft 365 admin center, and inventory which agents hold the Work IQ MCP server today.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Copilot Chat's Planner Agent gains task assignment, scheduled catch-up and Copilot memory in December 2026, with no admin switch
item.description:
An agent that can assign Planner tasks to people and uses Copilot memory widens what Copilot does on a user's behalf; there is no separate admin control named.

Copilot · Tell users and the help desk that the Planner Agent can now assign tasks; check whether Copilot memory is governed in your tenant before December.

item.title: [New] Microsoft 365 admin center retires the Project usage report on 4 December 2026 - export what you need by 20 November
item.description:

M365 admin · Export the Project usage report before 20 November 2026 and point licence reviews at the Planner usage report.

item.title: [New] Work IQ APIs start using Copilot connector data and tools from connected enterprise systems, rolling out late November to late December
item.description:

Copilot · List the Copilot connectors enabled in the tenant and the user-connected sources in Copilot Chat, and confirm the connector governance policies are what you want agents to inherit before late November.
